description: Read a Unity asset through the shared LocusBridge Property Tree. Start with the asset path, then pass returned child paths back to this tool until the relevant object, component, or field is verified; use unity_yaml_search only when the target path is unknown. `path` always contains both the Unity asset path and the optional internal property path, for example `Assets/Actions/LightNormalAttack1.asset/hitTrack/clips/4`. When Unity is connected, the tool reads the live Editor object graph first so unsaved values and hierarchy changes are visible; disk YAML is a strict fallback after live resolution fails. Every read attempts a compact expansion and returns all non-array descendants when the result stays within 4,000 characters, regardless of `depth`. Larger trees use the progressive outline: the selected node is level 0, direct children are level 1, and `depth` controls expansion. Arrays always expose at most four items, including compact expansions, while every index remains directly addressable. A compound asset root lists every same-file Subasset in a separate addressable hierarchy. The first same-file ObjectReference reached through serialized properties claims the child; arrays retain index order, shared/cyclic references keep their first canonical path, and non-serialized runtime fields never participate. Append the displayed hierarchy segments to the asset path to read that object. Loaded Scene roots expose their live GameObject hierarchy. Vectors, quaternions, colors, bounds, curves, and gradients are inline values that do not consume depth. Derived context without a readable path, such as World Position and Parent, appears in separate sections. Continue by passing any returned child or Subasset path back to this tool. Same-file ObjectReferences are expanded at their first serialized C# field location. The tool never returns a whole raw YAML file or repeats asset metadata headers.

path.description: Asset-qualified Property Tree path such as `Assets/Actions/LightNormalAttack1.asset` or `Assets/Actions/LightNormalAttack1.asset/hitTrack/clips/4`. Use `~0` for `~` and `~1` for `/` inside one field-name segment.

depth.description: Number of child levels in the progressive outline when full non-array expansion would exceed 4,000 characters. Defaults to 2 and is hard-clamped to 4. Trees within 4,000 characters expand completely even when depth is explicitly provided; arrays remain capped at four preview items.
